codeSourceFields.originHint: The code is installed and read when the source is saved; its functions tagged @table, @command or @stream become its tables, commands and live tables.
codeSourceFields.lockfileHint: Optional. For identical installs, which matter for testing, the code must carry a lockfile or you give one here ({{names}}).
codeSourceFields.entryHint: The module the source is entered by. Leave empty when the code has one top-level module or package.
codeSourceFields.secretsHint: The organization secrets this code may read. It fetches each one when it runs, from $PROVISA_SERVICES/secrets/<name>; nothing else in the vault is readable, and every read is audited.
codeSourceFields.llmCapHint: What this code's calls to $PROVISA_SERVICES/llm may cost each month (UTC), in USD. With a cap, it may use only models priced in Polly model prices, and its calls are refused once the month reaches the cap. Empty: no cap.
codeSourceFields.workersHint: How many workers this source runs in each Provisa process. A column transform's batches run side by side across them, so more workers raise its throughput.
codeSourceFields.settingsHint: Values the code reads with settings.get(name), one name = value to a line. Not for secrets: those go under Secrets. A steward changes them here without changing the code.
